title: Oozy Greek Chickpeas Revithia
description: A pungent and creamy Greek dish featuring free-range egg and lacquer-glaze, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this dairy-free-friendly recipe is served in a slate-tile vessel and has a revithia form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beaten egg and lacquer-glaze until well combined.
Add the chickpeas, olive oil, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir until the chickpeas are fully coated.
Transfer the mixture to a slate-tile vessel and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley on top.
Return the vessel to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Oozy Greek Chickpeas Revithia hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
